gpu_tip: ~74GB total at 128K context — the BF16 build is the heaviest way to run Laguna XS 2.1, but it's still a sparse 3B-active MoE, so most of those weights sit idle on any given token. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) keeps the always-on attention/shared layers at full speed while llama.cpp offloads the inactive experts to a 96GB DDR5 kit.
mac_tip: Needs ~74GB — fits a 96GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max/M5 Max) comfortably.
